# Release Notes - Normal Server Docker Launcher

- Simplified server Docker setup to one normal launcher path: `autobyteus-docker new-container`.
- Removed the mobile-safe Docker profile from public launcher guidance, Settings > Nodes > Docker Guide, and active documentation.
- Improved Phone Setup guidance to focus on private HTTPS/Tailscale pairing for the current node, with no Docker profile terminology.
- Preserved Docker `/mobile` packaging so fresh server Docker containers continue to serve the mobile pairing shell.
